title: Race only at a licensed racecourse
what: Hold a race for a stake, prize or betting only if the race is licensed by RWWA and held at a racecourse RWWA has licensed (ss 4 to 6 for thoroughbred, harness and greyhound racing).

sources.title: Racing Restriction Act 2003 (WA)
sources.publisher: WA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A thoroughbred race for a stake or prize or for the purpose of betting must not be held unless the race — (a) is licensed by RWWA under the RWWA Act; and (b) is held at a racecourse that is licensed by RWWA under the RWWA Act
